title: Social Worker – Hospice
description:
Social Worker - Hospice

If you are an experienced Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), Licensed Master Social Worker (LMSW), Licensed Clinical Marriage and Family Therapist, or FL Registered Intern with interest in a rewarding Hospice career, then you need to read on...

Social Worker Opportunity Description

Our client is a well-established Hospice organization. They have a current opening for a Hospice Social Worker for their Port Charlotte, FL and surrounding areas.  Hospice or Home Health experience is ideal but Social Workers with 1 year of experience in another setting and interest in Hospice care will be considered. These are full-time positions with benefits.  Hourly rate depends on experience. 

Social Worker Job Requirements 
  • 1+ years of Social Worker experience in any setting.  Hospice or Home Health experience strongly preferred but not required.
  • Florida Licensed Clinical Social Workers, Licensed Mental Health Counselors or Licensed Clinical Marriage and Family Therapist; Florida Registered Interns welcome to apply.
  • Reliable transportation – there is mileage reimbursement for home visits.
Social Worker Job Responsibilities
  • Ensure social service needs of the patient and their families is met.
  • Ensure compliance with all state and federal regulations.
  • Must attend in-office staff meetings when required.
The compensation scale listed is a general salary range and is not intended to represent the actual annual or hourly compensation rate for this role. An offer will be made to the selected candidate at the conclusion of the interview process based on their relevant experience and the responsibilities of the position. Our client does offer a competitive compensation package potentially including incentives, health and dental insurance, PTO, retirement plans (401K) and opportunities for professional development.

title: Regional Director of Hospice Operations
description:
Regional Director of Hospice Operations

If you are an experienced Area / Regional Vice President, Area / Regional Director, Area Administrator, or Executive Director, with Home Health or Hospice experience, then you need to read on...

Regional Director of Hospice Operations Description

Our client is a well-established Hospice organization. They have a current opening for a Regional Director of Hospice Operations for their Hospice locations in Michigan. Candidates in the greater Detroit, MI area are preferred but other areas may be considered as well as long as candidates can travel up 25% as needed. Medicare Hospice or Home Health leadership experience is required. This person will manage operations, financials, clinical performance, census & revenue growth, and help to create a positive culture.  Clinical and non-clinical candidates will be considered. Relocation candidates welcome to apply.

Regional Director of Hospice Operations Requirements
  • Strong single-site or multi-site operational leadership experience in Home Health or Hospice.
  • Excellent understanding of Medicare regulations and COP’s.
  • Strong financial and business development acumen.
 
Regional Director of Hospice Operations Job Responsibilities
  • Oversee operations & financials for multiple area locations.
  • Oversight of directly reporting leaders.
  • Ensure compliance with all state and federal regulations.
  • Work with business development team to grow census.
 
The compensation scale listed is a general salary range and is not intended to represent the actual annual or hourly compensation rate for this role. An offer will be made to the selected candidate at the conclusion of the interview process based on their relevant experience and the responsibilities of the position. Our client does offer a competitive compensation package potentially including incentives, health and dental insurance, PTO, retirement plans (401K) and opportunities for professional development.

title: Vice President of Market Growth – Healthcare
description:
Vice President of Market Growth – Healthcare

If you are an experienced Senior Vice President of Business Development, VP of Expansion,  Sr. Director of New Markets or a senior healthcare leader with De Novo / Startup experience then you need to read on...

Vice President of Market Growth Opportunity Description

A  leading Healthcare organization is looking to add a Vice President of Market Growth to their organization to help drive growth through De Novo startups and M&A.  This is a high-travel role that can be based in the Central or Eastern time zones to facilitate these high travel demands. Hands-on multi-site healthcare experience with start-ups, M&A and scaling through market expansion is required. For-Profit or Private Equity experience is strongly preferred.

Vice President of Market Growth Job Requirements
  • Multi-site Healthcare market expansion experience required. Preferred industries include Applied Behavioral Analysis (ABA), Behavioral or Mental Health, Clinic & Physician groups, SNF’s, ALFs/LTCs/ILF’s or similar settings.
  • Proven experience leading De Novo and M&A processes.
  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Ability to travel 75% or more in the Eastern half of the United States.
 
Vice President of Market Growth Job Responsibilities
  • Develop, implement, and execute on De Novo procedures including market analysis, procurement of physical sites, permitting, licensure, and standing up new markets.
  • Monitor KPI’s and financial performance during launches.
  • Hire, train, mentor local leadership during launch phase.
  • Lead integrations with new acquisitions.
  • Participate in growth strategy including M&A and start-up planning.
 
The compensation scale listed is a general salary range and is not intended to represent the actual annual or hourly compensation rate for this role. An offer will be made to the selected candidate at the conclusion of the interview process based on their relevant experience and the responsibilities of the position. Our client does offer a competitive compensation package potentially including incentives, health and dental insurance, PTO, retirement plans (401K) and opportunities for professional development.
